label: Missing Creditor Name Or Address
definition: Specification of the creditor’s name and/or address needed for regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing.

name: RegulatoryReason
label: Regulatory Reason
definition: Regulatory Reason

name: RegulatoryInformationInvalid
label: Regulatory Information Invalid
definition: Regulatory or Central Bank Reporting information missing, incomplete or invalid.

name: TaxInformationInvalid
label: Tax Information Invalid
definition: Tax information missing, incomplete or invalid.

name: RemittanceInformationInvalid
label: Remittance Information Invalid
definition: Remittance information structure does not comply with rules for payment type.

name: RemittanceInformationTruncated
label: Remittance Information Truncated
definition: Remittance information truncated to comply with rules for payment type.

name: InvalidStructuredCreditorReference
label: Invalid Structured Creditor Reference
definition: Structured creditor reference invalid or missing.

name: InvalidCharacterSet
label: Invalid Character Set
definition: Character set supplied not valid for the country and payment type.

name: InvalidDebtorAgentServiceID
label: Invalid Debtor Agent Service ID
definition: Invalid or missing identification of a bank proprietary service.

name: InvalidPartyID
label: Invalid Party ID
definition: Invalid or missing identification required within a particular country or payment type.

name: RTPNotSupportedForDebtor
label: RTP Not Supported For Debtor
definition: Debtor does not support request-to-pay transactions.

name: ReturnUponUnableToApply
label: Return Upon Unable To Apply
definition: Return following investigation request and no remediation possible.

name: ValidRequestForCancellationAcknowledged
label: Valid Request For Cancellation Acknowledged
definition: Request for Cancellation is acknowledged following validation.

name: UETRFlaggedForCancellation
label: UETR Flagged For Cancellation
definition: Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference (UETR) relating to a payment has been identified as being associated with a Request for Cancellation.

name: NetworkStopOfUETR
label: Network Stop Of UETR
definition: Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference (UETR) relating to a payment has been prevent from traveling across a messaging network.

name: RequestForCancellationForwarded
label: Request For Cancellation Forwarded
definition: Request for Cancellation has been forwarded to the payment processing/last payment processing agent.

name: RequestForCancellationDeliveryAcknowledgement
label: Request For Cancellation Delivery Acknowledgement
definition: Request for Cancellation has been acknowledged as delivered to payment processing/last payment processing agent.

name: SettlementBatchRemovalNotification
label: Settlement Batch Removal Notification
definition: Remove Concurrent Batch Processing Line on hold instruction.

name: SpecificServiceOfferedByDebtorAgent
label: Specific Service Offered By Debtor Agent
definition: Due to specific service offered by the Debtor Agent.

name: SpecificServiceOfferedByCreditorAgent
label: Specific Service Offered By Creditor Agent
definition: Due to specific service offered by the Creditor Agent.

name: ServiceofClearingSystem
label: Serviceof Clearing System
definition: Due to a specific service offered by the clearing system.

name: CreditorNotOnWhitelistOfDebtor
label: Creditor Not On Whitelist Of Debtor
definition: Whitelisting service offered by the Debtor Agent; Debtor has not included the Creditor on its “Whitelist” (yet). In the Whitelist the Debtor may list all allowed Creditors to debit Debtor bank account.

name: CreditorOnBlacklistOfDebtor
label: Creditor On Blacklist Of Debtor
definition: Blacklisting service offered by the Debtor Agent; Debtor included the Creditor on his “Blacklist”. In the Blacklist the Debtor may list all Creditors not allowed to debit Debtor bank account.

name: MaximumNumberOfDirectDebitTransactionsExceeded
label: Maximum Number Of Direct Debit Transactions Exceeded
definition: Due to Maximum allowed Direct Debit Transactions per period service offered by the Debtor Agent.

name: MaximumDirectDebitTransactionAmountExceeded
label: Maximum Direct Debit Transaction Amount Exceeded
definition: Due to Maximum allowed Direct Debit Transaction amount service offered by the Debtor Agent.

name: MaximumNumberOfCreditTransactionsExceeded
label: Maximum Number Of Credit Transactions Exceeded
definition: Maximum number of credit transactions allowed by the account servicer per service period exceeded.
requester: CR1418/Federal Reserve Bank of New York

name: MaximumCreditTransactionsAmountExceeded
label: Maximum Credit Transactions Amount Exceeded
definition: Maximum total credit amount allowed by the account servicer per service period exceeded.
requester: CR1418/Federal Reserve Bank of New York

name: DebtorNotOnWhitelistOfCreditorSide
label: Debtor Not On Whitelist Of Creditor Side
definition: Whitelisting service offered by payment system operator or financial institution. Debtor is not included on the Creditor side whitelist.
requester: CR1418/Federal Reserve Bank of New York

name: DebtorOnBlacklistOfCreditorSide
label: Debtor On Blacklist Of Creditor Side
definition: Blacklisting service offered by payment system operator or financial institution. Debtor included on the Creditor side blacklist.
requester: CR1418/Federal Reserve Bank of New York

name: ServiceNotRendered
label: Service Not Rendered
definition: Services are not yet rendered by the Payee Participant (Creditor).
additional_information: Used by the Payer Participant (Creditor) to decline the pain.013 request initiated by Payee Bank.

name: RTPServiceProviderIdentifierIncorrect
label: RTP Service Provider Identifier Incorrect
definition: Identifier of the request-to-pay service provider is incorrect.

name: TransmissonAborted
label: Transmisson Aborted
definition: The transmission of the file was not successful – it had to be aborted (for technical reasons)

name: NoDataAvailable
label: No Data Available
definition: There is no data available (for download)

name: FileNonReadable
label: File Non Readable
definition: The file cannot be read (e.g. unknown format)

name: IncorrectFileStructure
label: Incorrect File Structure
definition: The file format is incomplete or invalid

name: TokenInvalid
label: Token Invalid
definition: Token is invalid.

name: SenderTokenNotFound
label: Sender Token Not Found
definition: Token used for the sender does not exist.

name: ReceiverTokenNotFound
label: Receiver Token Not Found
definition: Token used for the receiver does not exist.

name: TokenMissing
label: Token Missing
definition: Token required for request is missing.

name: TokenCounterpartyMismatch
label: Token Counterparty Mismatch
definition: Token found with counterparty mismatch.

name: TokenSingleUse
label: Token Single Use
definition: Single Use Token already used.

name: TokenSuspended
label: Token Suspended
definition: Token found with suspended status.

name: TokenValueLimitExceeded
label: Token Value Limit Exceeded
definition: Token found with value limit rule violation.

name: TokenExpired
label: Token Expired
definition: Token expired.

name: InvalidCutOffTime
label: Invalid Cut Off Time
definition: Associated message, payment information block, or transaction was received after agreed processing cut-off time.

name: TransmissionSuccessful
label: Transmission Successful
definition: The (technical) transmission of the file was successful.

name: TransferToSignByHand
label: Transfer To Sign By Hand
definition: The order was transferred to pass by accompanying note signed by hand

name: UnknownCreditor
label: Unknown Creditor
definition: Unknown Creditor.

name: UnduePayment
label: Undue Payment
definition: Payment is not justified.

name: Adjustment
label: Adjustment
definition: Average balance to be held in the settlement account at the end of each day in order to fulfil the reserve due. The approximation will be always made rounding up.

name: AvailableDMVForDiscountWindowRepo
label: Available DMV For Discount Window Repo
definition: Balance represents the available discounted market value for discount window repo.

name: AvailableDMVForIntradayRepo
label: Available DMV For Intraday Repo
definition: Balance represents the available discounted market value for intraday repo.

name: Available
label: Available
definition: Balance of money or securities that is at the disposal of the account owner on the date specified.

name: Blocked
label: Blocked
definition: Balance representing the regulatory reserve that a financial institution must have with the account servicing institution, such as the minimum credit balance a financial institution is to keep with its Central Bank for mandatory reserve purposes. In some countries, a blocked balance is known as a 'reserve' balance.

name: BlockedTrades
label: Blocked Trades
definition: Balance representing the projected total of all cash legs for trades settling via a central securities depository that have been matched but blocked in order to not settle. These blocked trades are included in the calculation for settlement (for example to avoid overdrafts). Usage rule: Blocking can be done by account owner or its counterparties. Usually this is done to chain transactions or to prioritise other trades. Blocked trades have an indicator that prevents the transactions from settling. Once matched, they can settle whenever the freeze is lifted. In this case they will move to FSET. Lifting the freeze can happen anytime during the day and the transaction will be settling in the next settlement cycle which can be the same day if the (international) central securities depository's operates several settlements cycles per day.

name: Book
label: Book
definition: Balance that is registered in the books of the account servicer.

name: BulkSettlementCMUPCredit
label: Bulk Settlement CMUP Credit
definition: Balance represents the total of the bulk settlement and central moneymarkets unit processor credit.

name: BulkSettlementCMUPDebit
label: Bulk Settlement CMUP Debit
definition: Balance represents the total of the bulk settlement and central moneymarkets unit processor debit.

name: CentralCounterparty
label: Central Counterparty
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded in exchanges that operate a central counterparty functionality.

name: Closing
label: Closing
definition: Balance of the account at the end of the account servicer's business day. It is the sum of the opening balance at the beginning of the day and all entries booked to the account during the account servicer's business day.

name: CreditOnHold
label: Credit On Hold
definition: Balance representing the total incoming payments that were put on hold because the credit limit has been exceeded.

name: DividendsCollection
label: Dividends Collection
definition: Balance representing the projected total amount of all payment obligations to the participant (bank), based on their role as main paying agent.

name: CreditProcessed
label: Credit Processed
definition: Balance representing the total incoming payments that have been processed and are waiting for settlement.

name: Credit
label: Credit
definition: Balance representing the sum of all credit entries booked to an account.

name: Current
label: Current
definition: Balance of the account at a precise moment in time.

name: CustodyActual
label: Custody Actual
definition: Balance representing the actual total of all asset servicing transactions such as dividends, income corporate actions equivalents, tax returns, redemptions, etc.

name: Custody
label: Custody
definition: Balance representing the projected total of all asset servicing transactions such as dividends, income corporate actions equivalents, tax returns, etc.

name: Debit
label: Debit
definition: Balance representing the sum of all debit entries booked to an account.

name: DaylightOverdraft
label: Daylight Overdraft
definition: Balance representing the intra day overdraft granted by the central bank to financial institutions participating in a RTGS system. This balance may vary over time and shall be offset at the end of the day.

name: DebitOnHold
label: Debit On Hold
definition: Balance representing the total outgoing payments that were put on hold because the debit limit has been exceeded.

name: DebitProcessed
label: Debit Processed
definition: Balance representing the total outgoing payments that have been processed and are waiting for settlement.

name: DefinitiveSettledSecurities
label: Definitive Settled Securities
definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent of all settled securities transactions.

name: DiscountWindowRepoDrawings
label: Discount Window Repo Drawings
definition: Balance represents the discount window repo drawings.

name: EligibleAssets
label: Eligible Assets
definition: Balance representing the potential loan a Central Bank would make in cash if the collateral is pledged, such as securities available and eligible as collateral with the central bank.

name: ExcessReserveExemptionThresholdExemptTier
label: Excess Reserve Exemption Threshold Exempt Tier
definition: The code defines the threshold to the value excess reserve exemption balance between the exempt and non-exempt tiers of excess reserve.

name: ExcessReserveRemunerationBalanceNonExemptTier
label: Excess Reserve Remuneration Balance Non Exempt Tier
definition: The code defines the balance beyond excess reserve exemption threshold within the periodic average balance for minimum reserve. Thus, this part of the excess reserve is still to be remunerated.

name: FirmCollateralisation
label: Firm Collateralisation
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the cash-equivalent resulting from evaluation of existing holdings at central securities depositary that are qualified to serve as collateral.

name: UsedAmountsFirmCollateralisation
label: Used Amounts Firm Collateralisation
definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent resulting from evaluation of existing holdings at CSD that are qualified to serve as collateral and have been used as collateral.

name: CashForecast
label: Cash Forecast
definition: Balance representing the total of all balance types representing transactions to settle, blocked items and custody transactions.

name: ForecastSettlement
label: Forecast Settlement
definition: Balance representing the forecast of total of all cash legs for trades that are ready to settle via a central securities depository. Amounts shown are still subject to processing of the securities settlement.

name: NetFunding
label: Net Funding
definition: Balance representing the net amount to be funded resulting from all transactions which have an impact on the funding requirement.

name: TotalFuture
label: Total Future
definition: Balance representing the total of the payments with a processing date in the future.

name: Interim
label: Interim
definition: Balance calculated in the course of the account servicer's business day, at the time specified, and subject to further changes during the business day. The interim balance is calculated on the basis of booked credit and debit items during the calculation time/period specified.

name: IntradayRepoDrawings
label: Intraday Repo Drawings
definition: Balance represents the intraday repo drawings.

name: IntradayRepoLimit
label: Intraday Repo Limit
definition: Balance represents the intraday repo limit.

name: LackOfHoldingsTransactions
label: Lack Of Holdings Transactions
definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent of transactions with a lack of holdings.

name: LimitRelated
label: Limit Related
definition: Balance of a specific limit value, such as a bilateral balance is calculated in relation to a given bilateral limit.

name: LiquidityTransfer
label: Liquidity Transfer
definition: Balance composed of the sum of all liquidity transfers made to or from an account.

name: Master
label: Master
definition: Balance of the identified account plus the balance of all of its subaccounts.

name: Noted
label: Noted
definition: Balance representing the amount that a financial institution has set aside for a specific reason and which is therefore not available.

name: NonSettledSecurities
label: Non Settled Securities
definition: Balance representing the cash equivalent of all non-settled securities transactions.

name: Opening
label: Opening
definition: Book balance of the account at the beginning of the account servicer's business day. It always equals the closing book balance from the previous business day. Note: the available balance at the beginning of the account servicer's business day may be different from the closing book balance from the previous business day.

name: CCPGuaranteedOTCTransactions
label: CCP Guaranteed OTC Transactions
definition: Balance representing the Forecast of the total of all cash-legs of transactions 'over the counter' (OTC), going through central counter party (CCP) functions.

name: ForecastOTCTransactions
label: Forecast OTC Transactions
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded 'over the counter' (OTC).

name: NonCCPGuaranteedOTCTransactions
label: Non CCP Guaranteed OTC Transactions
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded 'over the counter' (OTC) not going through central counter party (CCP) functions.

name: OtherBlockedTrades
label: Other Blocked Trades
definition: Balance representing the projected total of all cash legs for trades settling via a central securities depository that have been matched but blocked in order to not settle. These blocked transactions are not included in the calculation for settlement.

name: Pending
label: Pending
definition: Balance of securities pending delivery, such as the orders to sell securities have been executed but settlement of the open transactions has not been confirmed.

name: PayInPayOut
label: Pay In Pay Out
definition: Balance representing the fictive forecast of automated direct debits or payment based on standing arrangements between a central securities depository and the user. Usage: Pay-Ins and Pay-Outs can be different based on individual payment instructions or available funds.

name: ProgressiveAverage
label: Progressive Average
definition: Average of the daily balances on the account used to fulfil the reserve requirements calculated from the beginning of the maintenance period.

name: Payment
label: Payment
definition: Balance representing the sum of entries as a result of payments processing. Entries relating to fees, interest, or other movements not a result of payments sent or received by the account owner are not included.

name: TotalRejected
label: Total Rejected
definition: Balance representing the total of the payments that have been rejected.

name: CMUPRepoCredit
label: CMUP Repo Credit
definition: Balance represents the total of the central moneymarkets unit processor repo credits.

name: CMUPRepoDebit
label: CMUP Repo Debit
definition: Balance represents the total of the central moneymarkets unit processor repo debits.

name: Restricted
label: Restricted
definition: Balance of cash that may only be used under certain conditions. Balance type is used to block securities/cash in the client account for example, when related to specific corporate actions, the holding is under the direct control of the system paying agent, who is the only one who can transfer securities out of this balance type. Also known as the "escrow balance" or "sequestered balance".

name: SAPDirectCreditAmount
label: SAP Direct Credit Amount
definition: Balance represents the settlement account processor direct credit amount.

name: SAPDirectDebitAmount
label: SAP Direct Debit Amount
definition: Balance represents the settlement account processor direct debit amount.

name: SAPQueueAmount
label: SAP Queue Amount
definition: Balance represents the settlement account processor queue amount.

name: SelfCollateralisation
label: Self Collateralisation
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the cash-equivalent resulting from evaluation of the net incoming balance of securities qualified to serve as collateral for which settlement instructions are held at.

name: UsedAmountsSelfCollateralisation
label: Used Amounts Self Collateralisation
definition: Balance representing the cash-equivalent resulting from evaluation of incoming securities, qualified to serve as collateral and actually used as collateral, which have been settled during the settlement process.

name: Self
label: Self
definition: Balance of the account identified (as opposed to Master Balance).

name: Threshold
label: Threshold
definition: Balance representing the amount that will be destined for investment. Difference between available balance and threshold for investment limit.

name: TotalOnHold
label: Total On Hold
definition: Balance representing the total of the payments that were put on hold because the limits have been exceeded.

name: TotalProcessed
label: Total Processed
definition: Balance representing the total of the payments that have been processed and are waiting for settlement during the day.

name: CCPGuaranteedForecasting
label: CCP Guaranteed Forecasting
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions in exchanges, going through CCP functions.

name: ExchangeForecast
label: Exchange Forecast
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded in exchanges.

name: NonCCPGuaranteedForecasting
label: Non CCP Guaranteed Forecasting
definition: Balance representing the forecast of the total of all cash legs of transactions traded in exchanges not going through central counter party (CCP) functions.

name: ExpectedCredit
label: Expected Credit
definition: Balance, composed of booked entries and pending items known at the time of calculation, which projects the end of day credit balance if everything books to the account and no other credit entry is posted.

name: ExpectedDebit
label: Expected Debit
definition: Balance, composed of booked entries and pending items known at the time of calculation, which projects the end of day debit balance if everything books to the account and no other debit entry is posted.

name: Expected
label: Expected
definition: Balance, composed of booked entries and pending items known at the time of calculation, which projects the end of day balance if everything is booked on the account and no other entry is posted.

name: DataNotYetAvailable
label: Data Not Yet Available
definition: Specifies the error code when the data requested are not yet available.

name: MessageSizeLimitExceeded
label: Message Size Limit Exceeded
definition: Specifies the error code when the data requested generates a message size that exceed the processing capacity.

name: DataNotAvailable
label: Data Not Available
definition: Specifies the error code when the data requested have not been found.

name: CashReservationCutOff
label: Cash Reservation Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the cash reservation window.

name: CustomerCutOff
label: Customer Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for customer payments.

name: EndOfStandingFacilities
label: End Of Standing Facilities
definition: Event is the cut off for the standing facilities.

name: Euro1CutOff
label: Euro 1 Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff time for the Euro1 system, that is, the deadline for processing Euro1 transactions.

name: Euro1StartUp
label: Euro 1 Start Up
definition: Event is the opening of the Euro 1 system operation.

name: FinalReporting
label: Final Reporting
definition: Event is the report after all operations have ceased in the system.

name: InterbankCutOff
label: Interbank Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for interbank payments.

name: LTDCutOff
label: LTD Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the settlement of the cash multilateral balances resulting from the daylight cycle of the securities settlement system.

name: LTGCutOff
label: LTG Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the daytime cycle of the securities settlement system.

name: LTNCutOff
label: LTN Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the settlement of the cash multilateral balances resulting from the overnight cycle of the securities settlement system.

name: LVPCancellationCutOff
label: LVP Cancellation Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff time after which low value payments can no longer be cancelled.

name: LVPCutOff
label: LVP Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff time for low value payments processed by the system.

name: LVPCutOffReportTime
label: LVP Cut Off Report Time
definition: Event is the time at which the members will be provided with the report corresponding to the processing of low value payments.

name: LimitWarningStartUp
label: Limit Warning Start Up
definition: Event is the start of the limit warning period.

name: NewPaymentCutOffTime
label: New Payment Cut Off Time
definition: Event is the cutoff time for the receipt of new commercial payments.

name: ProcessingCutOffTime
label: Processing Cut Off Time
definition: Event is the cutoff time for the processing of payments.

name: RecCutOff
label: Rec Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the settlement of the multilateral balances stemming from the retail clearing system.

name: ResumeOperation
label: Resume Operation
definition: Event is the expected resume time for a TARGET component.

name: NetSSSReservationCutOff
label: Net SSS Reservation Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the securities settlement system cash reservation window.

name: StartOfDay
label: Start Of Day
definition: Event is the start of the operating day.

name: Step1StartUp
label: Step 1 Start Up
definition: Event is the start of the Step 1 system operation.

name: SystemCutOff
label: System Cut Off
definition: Event is the cutoff for the system.

name: Direct
label: Direct
definition: Member has full rights in the system. In principle, this membership status entails financial responsibility for its own operations and sponsored members' operations submitted to the system.

name: EURO1
label: EURO 1
definition: Member is entitled to access the Euro1 system of the Euro Banking Association (EBA).

name: Indirect
label: Indirect
definition: Member has limited rights in the system specifications. In principle, this membership status entails no financial responsibility for its operations submitted to the system.

name: Remote
label: Remote
definition: Member has access to the system from a remote location or through remote technical means.

name: STEP1
label: STEP 1
definition: Member is entitled to access the Step1 system of the Euro Banking Association (EBA).

name: AncillarySystem
label: Ancillary System
definition: System in which payments and/or financial instruments are exchanged and/or cleared or recorded, while the ensuing monetary obligations are settled in another system, typically an RTGS system

name: CentralSecuritiesDepositoryParticipant
label: Central Securities Depository Participant
definition: Legal entity or, as the case may be, an individual having a contractual relationship with the CSD for the processing of its securities settlement-related activities in T2S.

name: CentralSecuritiesDepository
label: Central Securities Depository
definition: Infrastructure that holds or controls the holding of physical or dematerialized financial instruments belonging to all, or a large portion of, the investors in a securities market. This effects the centralized transfer of ownership of such securities by entries on its books and records.

name: ExternalCentralSecuritiesDepository
label: External Central Securities Depository
definition: Infrastructure that holds or controls the holding of physical or dematerialized financial instruments belonging to all, or a large portion of, the investors in a securities market. This effects the centralized transfer of ownership of such securities by entries on its books and records. The infrastructure is external to the system executing the instruction.

name: NationalCentralBank
label: National Central Bank
definition: As system participant, the national central bank is the principal monetary authority of a nation and performs several key functions, including issuing currency and regulating the supply of credit in the economy.

name: PaymentBank
label: Payment Bank
definition: Commercial bank used to effect money settlements.

name: StandardParticipantRestricted
label: Standard Participant Restricted
definition: Party that owns an account in the system, but only supports a limited range of available use cases in interaction with counterparties.

name: StandardParticipantUnrestricted
label: Standard Participant Unrestricted
definition: Party that owns an account in the system and can interact with the system or counterparties using all use cases available to standard participants.

name: SystemManager
label: System Manager
definition: Party that defines the eligibility criteria of the system and is responsible for monitoring, controlling and, if necessary, operating the system. All authorizations are available to the system manager when interacting with the system.

name: SystemOperator
label: System Operator
definition: Party that operates the system on behalf of the system manager (if different from the system manager) and is provided with specific authorizations by the system manager for this purpose.

name: CityTax
label: City Tax
definition: Tax accessed by city jurisdications within a country.

name: CountyTax
label: County Tax
definition: Tax accessed by county jurisdications within a country.

name: LocalTax
label: Local Tax
definition: Tax accessed by local jurisdications within a country.

name: ProvinceTax
label: Province Tax
definition: Tax accessed by province jurisdications within a country.

name: StateTax
label: State Tax
definition: Tax accessed by state jurisdications within a country.

name: Fax
label: Fax
definition: Technical Input Channel is fax or facsimile

name: Paper
label: Paper
definition: Technical Input Channel is paper

name: Tape
label: Tape
definition: Technical Input Channel is tape

name: Internet
label: Internet
definition: Technical Input Channel is internet

name: FactoringDomestic
label: Factoring Domestic
definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client and third party in the same country

name: FactoringExport
label: Factoring Export
definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client in the same country, third party in another country

name: FactoringForeignDomestic
label: Factoring Foreign Domestic
definition: Factoring client and third party in the same country, Factoring service provider in another country

name: FactoringFrenchDomTom
label: Factoring French Dom Tom
definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client and third party in the same country, but factoring client has an exceptional VAT ruling, for example if it’s overseas

name: FactoringImport
label: Factoring Import
definition: Factoring service provider and third party in the same country, Factoring client in another country

name: FactoringReexportedExport
label: Factoring Reexported Export
definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client and third party in three different countries

name: BoardLot
label: Board Lot
definition: Board lots, not set for odd lots (UK specific).

name: BadName
label: Bad Name
definition: Bad names, not set for good names (UK specific).

name: DeliveryForm
label: Delivery Form
definition: Form of delivery, not for foreign registration when unset (UK specific).

name: DeliverCountryIncorporation
label: Deliver Country Incorporation
definition: Place of delivery, in country of incorporation when unset (UK specific).

name: ResultOption
label: Result Option
definition: Result of option when set (UK specific).

name: ResultRepo
label: Result Repo
definition: Result of repo when set (UK specific).

name: Block
label: Block
definition: The trade is a block trade or not, ie, whether allocation instruction will follow or not.

name: BestExecution
label: Best Execution
definition: Trade to be executed done at best execution.

name: BoughtMinus
label: Bought Minus
definition: Bought minus indicator.

name: Call
label: Call
definition: Trade to be executed following the exercise of a call option on the security.

name: CumBonus
label: Cum Bonus
definition: Trade is executed cum bonus.

name: CumCoupon
label: Cum Coupon
definition: Trade is executed cum coupon.

name: CumDividend
label: Cum Dividend
definition: Trade is executed cum dividend.

name: ClosureBeforeRollOver
label: Closure Before Roll Over
definition: Trade to be executed for closure of a previous position before the rollover of a position (Deferred Settlement Service).

name: Clean
label: Clean
definition: Trade is executed clean, ie government tax must not be paid on the accrued interest on the bond.

name: CrossTrade
label: Cross Trade
definition: Cross trades are allowed whereby buy and sell orders are offset without recording the trade on the exchange

name: CumRights
label: Cum Rights
definition: Trade is executed cum rights.

name: CumWarrant
label: Cum Warrant
definition: Trade is executed cum warrant.

name: DirectedOrder
label: Directed Order
definition: Customer order where the customer gives specific instructions to the broker concerning the orders routing destination.

name: Dirty
label: Dirty
definition: Trade is executed dirty, ie government tax must be paid on the accrued interest on the bond.

name: DirectOrder
label: Direct Order
definition: Order is to be executed by a trading party other than the trading party to which the order is sent. In this case, the instructing party has traded with another broker which will subsequently send an advice of execution to the executing party who received the order and which is acting as clearing broker.

name: ForwardPriceTrade
label: Forward Price Trade
definition: Order is based on a forward price.

name: Fractions
label: Fractions
definition: Fractional parts are allowed.

name: GuaranteedDelivery
label: Guaranteed Delivery
definition: Delivery of the financial instrument on settlement date is guaranteed.

name: HistoricPriceTrade
label: Historic Price Trade
definition: Order is based on a historic price.

name: MarketPrice
label: Market Price
definition: Trade was executed at market price.

name: Monthly
label: Monthly
definition: Trade to be executed for month-end settlement (Deferred Settlement Service).

name: NewTradeFollowingRollover
label: New Trade Following Rollover
definition: Trade to be executed for a new trade position on the next month following the roll-over of a position (Deferred Settlement Service).

name: NoCrossTrade
label: No Cross Trade
